cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your cupboard's finished. I've left the shelves loose so you can choose the heights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It's complete as an adjustable kit. Position everything around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fasten one shelf at your chosen height. A finished sample, so you can approve the rest.

mechanism: A presents incomplete installation as a deliberately finished teaching kit for a pupil and each demanded correction as another complete lesson.
confusable: Not merely delaying work: A keeps claiming the unfinished form is thoughtful completion with a purpose.
comparison: Physical installation sold as practice kit versus missing report data sold as a participatory format.
seedUse: Use D41 loose shelves/supports/drill/sample; S05 pupil practice makes the claimed deliberate incompleteness persuasive.
